trigger: User wants normal in-product user creation instead of relying on ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET, and current data model already supports multiple members and multiple students.
intent: Add in-family member management: list members, owner can create editor/viewer accounts, change role, disable/re-enable access.
Add child creation inside the current family for owner/editor accounts; existing student selector must immediately support multiple children after reload.
Keep independent new-family provisioning behind ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET; this change is for managing an existing family.
Never expose password records or runtime secrets through member APIs.
Viewer accounts remain read-only; owner-only actions must be enforced server-side, not just hidden in UI.
Preserve existing exams, sharing, KV key contract, secret deployment hardening and v0.1.5 share-copy behavior.
delivered: Authenticated /api/family/members GET+POST and /api/family/members/:id PATCH with owner-only mutations.
Member role changes and disable/re-enable increment sessionVersion, invalidating old sessions.
Authenticated /api/family/students POST for owner/editor, with viewer denied server-side.
Settings enhancement for member list/create/role/access management and adding another child.
Viewer settings are explicitly read-only; passwords and bootstrap secret are never rendered or returned.
Integration and UI/security contract tests added; package and Worker runtime bumped to 0.1.6.
resumeRule: Resume from PR #8 latest head. Do not re-run admin provisioning for the existing family and do not weaken v0.1.1+ Worker-secret deployment protections. Merge only after final PR-head CI is green, then verify main CI, Cloudflare deploy and production health 0.1.6.
